title: 下单用户数
question: 上个月上海的下单用户数
sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS buyer_count
FROM orders AS o
JOIN stores AS s
  ON o.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  AND s.city = '上海'
LIMIT 1000

FROM (

    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,
    region_id,
    status,
    store_id
  FROM orders

JOIN (

    store_name,
